periods.time: During Dragunov's underground arena event in Shinjuku
periods.label: 地下斗技场负责人亚科夫
periods.occupation: Russian mafia boss; illegal arena operator

status.current: defeated and arrested after Hagun students raid the arena

relationships.smiley: Client/contact whom he intends to introduce to Dragunov headquarters.
relationships.kanata-tokutomiya: Threat he fears after seeing her dismantle the emergency-exit guards.
relationships.toka-todo: Infiltrator who knocks him down in the VIP room.

periods.summary: Yakov runs Dragunov's illegal Blazer gambling arena under Shinjuku. He hosts Smiley and plans to arrange a new sponsor and a submarine escape route for the Rebellion remnants. When Hagun students reveal themselves, he turns the arena into a bounty hunt against them, but the fighters are defeated. After seeing Kanata's approach through security footage, he tries to use a hidden VIP escape tunnel, only for Toka to have already infiltrated the room. Toka shocks him unconscious before arresting Smiley.

key_events.summary: Orders the bounty hunt but loses the arena and escape route to Hagun's raid.
